inputs.text: Vertical cinematic two-person composition presented as a clean video-call split frame. On the left, the same adult Chinese woman age 28 in her apartment, same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and silver necklace, frightened but attentive, slowly lowering her phone. On the right, an adult Chinese male police officer age 35 with square face and short neat black hair wears a dark navy duty uniform without readable badge numbers and raises one open palm in a firm stop gesture. Both are premium handcrafted 3D plush dolls with soft flocked fabric and subtle seams, rounded chibi adult proportions. The woman's side shifts from cold to warmer light; the officer side is neutral professional light. No text, no badge numbers, no watermark, correct hands. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: the woman holds her phone near her face while the police officer faces camera. Action: the officer raises one open palm in a firm stop gesture and speaks calmly; the woman relaxes her shoulders and slowly lowers the phone to chest level. End: both hold steady, the woman visibly relieved. Motion is controlled and professional. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. No dialogue or lip movement.
